answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade: one identity, one bond, slashed if it cheats. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake separately, so every fake island it spawns costs a full stake, while honest agents get theirs back. Like a lagoon that only admits boats carrying real cargo, the bond filters cheap identities at the horizon of entry, turning forgery from a free copy-paste into an expensive, auditable commitment.
